Mark D: Heads-up: Luminar Health sent an RFI. They want a capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, and a 2-week POC that proves HSM-backed keys in a regional (eu-west-1) deployment. They also asked for SLO targets and a short-runbook for incidents. Deadline EOD tomorrow. Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/luminar/rfi. Can we scope? cc @Priya @Owen
Priya S: We can do a POC. Key questions: do they require customer HSM (PKCS#11) or cloud HSM/CMEK? Customer HSM implies Private/VPC or on-prem and a bit more setup.
Owen L: From the thread they explicitly asked for "HSM-backed key material (customer HSM)". So recommend Private deployment with VPC peering + a PKCS#11 endpoint. That needs network team on their side and a short SOW. Timeline: ~5 business days to provision once networking is ready.
Karen W: Ill draft the capability matrix rows: "Customer HSM (Private only)", "CMEK (Dedicated/Hosted)", "Regional inference nodes (eu-west-1)", "No-internet egress option during POC", "Audit log export / SIEM forwarding", "Per-route latency dashboards". Will attach after edit.
infra-bot: Reservation check: 2 x A40-equivalent nodes available in eu-west-1 for a 14-day window starting 2026-05-03 pending PO. VPC peering window requires customer's network tunnels and route table entries.
Mark D: Pricing suggestions? We should present two packages: (A) Private POC (customer HSM): SOW + infra + support; (B) Hosted/Dedicated POC (CMEK): faster, lower setup. Include optional live audit support.
Priya S: Draft pricing: (A) Private POC: SOW $16k (HSM integration) + infra $9k/week + support $1.5k/day for live audit. (B) Dedicated pilot (CMEK): $6k/week + $0.00065/token overage. Flagged provisional. I'll upload sheet.
Owen L: Note for the runtime team: they asked whether we can fallback to a smaller model if capacity constrained. We support policy-driven fallbacks, but tokenization compatibility must be verified. Add example YAML for RFI: ``fallback_policy:
  - prefer: redwood-large
    fallback: redwood-medium
    conditions: [gpu_util>82, latency_p95>200ms]``
Karen W: Security snippet for RFI (short form): ``KMS/HSM: Customer HSMs supported for Private via PKCS#11; Hosted/Dedicated supports cloud KMS (CMEK). SOC2 Type II (2025) available under NDA. Audit logs exportable to customer S3/GCS or forwarded to SIEM. Data residency: inference nodes can be placed in requested region; no-internet egress option available during controlled POC.``
legal-bot: NDA required before sharing SOC2 and pentest artifacts. I can pre-send NDA template to Luminar if sales confirms.
Mark D: Action items: Karen - finish matrix & attach (mark pricing provisional). Priya - upload pricing draft and flag discount policy. Owen - confirm node reservation + monitoring hooks. I'll draft outbound email and loop legal for NDA. Target send by 08:30 tomorrow. Keep replies short. :rocket:
